description: This file defines a Python class `TranscriptionUserTurnStartStrategy` that extends a base strategy class to detect the start of a user turn based on transcription frames during a speech recognition process. The class includes methods for initializing the strategy and processing frames to determine when a user turn has started, particularly when transcription data is received while the bot is speaking.

classes.name: TranscriptionUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: A strategy for detecting the start of a user turn based on transcription frames. It signals the beginning of a user turn when specific transcription frames are received, useful as a fallback when voice activity detection (VAD) fails.

methods.name: __init__(self, *, use_interim: bool = True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the strategy, allowing configuration to use interim transcriptions.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame to determine if it signals the start of a user turn, triggering the appropriate event if conditions are met.
